bio: Eutimio occupies an attractive property with a homely feel in a unique setting (although parking can occasionally be a problem). The traditionally focused à la carte is centred around fish and seafood, and is enhanced by interesting market-inspired daily suggestions. Several dishes require pre-ordering, such as the “caldereta” of fish and seafood, and the rice with lobster. The same goes for its hugely popular version of the traditional “cachopo” stew (the restaurant’s “Cacholetus” dish won Spain’s inaugural “cachopo” competition)....
